params.body:
Since people outside the team read the Observatory through a plan on gentells.com, the Accounts page held two kinds of access in one list: a role set by hand for the team, and a plan for everyone else. They looked alike and were managed alike.

- **Two lists, same columns.** *Team*: admins and members, with the invitation; inviting, a role and leaving the team happen here. *Members of gentells.com*: every other account, with plan, trial and blocking, and how many are on the Observatory plan. A removed team member and a guest are members.
- **Observatory access in one click.** A member's row has "Give Observatory access" (plan `observatory`) or, when on it, "Take it away (back to Explore)". The Observatory column says "Reads, as a guest" once they have signed in, "Reads, not signed in yet" before.
- **Team from a member's row.** Inviting a guest to the team goes through an invitation, since the pipeline refuses to turn a guest's role into a team role.
- The invitation's send button is in the call-to-action colour instead of black.
- Settings: the Team block that no longer rendered (the team moved to Accounts on 2 October) is removed with its imports.

Checks: build, lint ratchet (at the ceiling), e2e 44 of 44, including a new spec for the two lists and the one-click access.
params.title: Accounts: the team and the members of gentells.com as two lists
